findings: events are red; most actions are green/blue
connection/data ports have required data types

script attachment scope changes semantics: Global vs Player script

important_pages.path: Craftland PC/English/4. Scripting and Logic/Code Script - User Manual.md
findings: .fcg are script files; .fcc are library files
EditorGenLib.fcc contains data registered in the editor and graph-based block scripts
Standard libraries are automatically imported when code scripts are created
script APIs/events have server/client scope and component/type metadata
API autocomplete and parameter hints are available in the official tooling

important_pages.path: Craftland PC/English/4. Scripting and Logic/Element Script - User Manual.md
findings: visual block shapes indicate statement/input/output wiring
blocks require compatible input types; incorrect values produce an editor error
global/entity and script/local variable scopes are distinct
custom events specify receiving entity type and payload parameters

documents loops and conditional blocks
supports mapping labels to PC code data types, not a Mobile dropdown export
ready-made examples for healing, damage, zombie spawning, traps, teleport/transfer, text UI, outfit change, elevator, automatic door, global/player/HUD/respawn scripts
images/screenshots can reveal block labels and selected inputs if inspected per recipe
object categories, item manager, weapon loot points, triggers, zombie configuration, and shop interactions
text documents some selectable dropdown concepts like weapon loot-point category and trigger type
custom room parameters expose player-configurable options before match start
logic frame update frequency and global event scope are important to correct code generation
per-player vs global event behavior explicitly explained
player module properties, controller and script scope
